infotexts.entitydescription.aegisservosuit: Powered exosuit rated to 10,000 m. Four slots in order: battery/reactor rod, ammunition, separately crafted servo arm module, separately crafted impeller module. No free modules are included. Arm functions require the servo; powered swimming requires the impeller. Removing the servo releases held targets and stops repair and firing. Life support, sonar and lights work without these modules. Requires client and server LuaCs.
infotexts.aegis.title: Servo arm
infotexts.aegis.grab_help: Point at the target. Hold [InputType.Aim] and press [InputType.Use], then release the keys. The target stays suspended. Press again while aiming to release. Creatures become temporarily limp. One loose object or creature, excluding massive targets; range 300. Changing mode, an obstacle, power loss or removing the suit releases the grip.
infotexts.aegis.hide_panel: Hide panel; the function stays enabled
